runs.rejection_summary: Researched three candidates against the static baseline profile. Two accepted: Carter (81) and Sisu (65), both dense and varied with a capable lead. Warrior was rejected at 52 - the martial arts are excellent but arrive in short bursts, and the period presentation plus heavy drama emphasis pull it under the 60 minimum; that is a verdict about this profile, not about the show. No candidate tripped the action_density hard exclusion this run. Personalization is dormant: no personalized-scores.json exists and none was created. Zero duplicates against the identity set.

No candidate tripped the action_density hard exclusion or any combination guardrail. Personalization remains dormant because data/personalized-scores.json is absent. Researched two current movie candidates against the static baseline profile. Accepted The Furious (73): multiple whole-runtime sources establish action_density 9, with the action beginning within minutes and leaving barely a quiet stretch thereafter; its varied martial-arts styles, stunt work and brutal close combat clear the 60 minimum without firing a guardrail. Mutiny was rejected because the whole-runtime evidence conflicts too sharply to establish action_density responsibly: one review describes evenly distributed action, while another describes slow pacing, dull exposition and only occasional bursts of intense action. Under the Action contract, uncertain density is not accepted. No hard-exclusion or below-threshold rejection was asserted for Mutiny because density was not responsibly measurable. Personalization remains dormant because data/personalized-scores.json is absent. The mandatory fresh final duplicate re-check found zero duplicates against the current public identity set and watched-exclusion set.

Researched two current movie candidates against the static baseline profile and accepted both: Hope (80) and The Wrecking Crew (66). Multiple whole-runtime sources support action_density 9 for Hope, describing a beginning-to-end high-octane, near-non-stop action spectacle despite some deliberate repetition; The Wrecking Crew is action_density 6, with brisk fights, lively car chases and recurring violence across its 124-minute buddy-conspiracy structure. Neither candidate triggered the action_density hard exclusion or any combination guardrail, and neither fell below the 60 minimum. No density, guardrail or below-threshold rejections this run.
